Stripe._comment: Set real values via user-secrets (dev) or env vars Stripe__SecretKey etc. (prod). WebhookSecret comes from `stripe listen` locally, or the dashboard webhook endpoint in prod. ClientUrl is where Checkout redirects back to.

Encryption._comment: Base64 of a 32-byte (256-bit) key for AES-256-GCM encryption of Plaid access tokens at rest. NEVER commit a real key — set via user-secrets (dev) or env var Encryption__TokenKey (prod). Generate: openssl rand -base64 32
